kind: run pack (E1: fault-injected training survival, official TRL path)
code_commit: ace6349 + F2 single-row injector fix (guarded_grpo_trainer.py capability gate, runtime_attest.py, fault_survival.py)
purpose: E1 acceptance: pre-registered wiring faults injected into the ACTUAL step tensors of the official GRPOTrainer; guard on/off x 2 seeds. Guard blocks every fault BEFORE loss/backward; the guard-off baseline applies the corrupted updates.
hardware: autodl2, 2x RTX 6000D 84GB (trainer GPU0, vLLM server GPU1, mem_util 0.25)
config: GRPOConfig(max_steps=30, per_device_train_batch_size=1, num_generations=4, max_completion_length=32, beta=0 (no ref model), gradient_checkpointing, use_vllm server); GSM8K-style prompts

faults.step 20: F2 old-logprob misbinding (values corrupted on the single-row slice)

results.guard-on (2 seeds): bad updates accepted 0/4; detection latency 0 steps; wasted steps 0; F3->T001 and F2->L004 blocked before backward; runs recovered on the clean batch
results.guard-off (seed 20260826): bad updates accepted 2/2 (corrupted updates APPLIED — on/off losses diverge from the first fault step, 19/30 steps differ); never detected; 30 wasted steps. NOTE: the paired seed-20260825 off arm was rerun as part of the 2026-08-26 audit fix but the shared-box GPU1 was occupied for hours; the pre-fix version is void (see docs/audits/2026-08-26_independent_audit.md)
results.overhead: mean step time on 0.354-0.364s vs off 0.360s (no significant difference at 30-step scale)
results.attestation: dual-source runtime fingerprint start/end CONSISTENT (stale_detected false) in all runs

audit_note: 2026-08-26 independent fresh-context audit found the original guard-off arm NEVER consumed the tampered batch (_prepare_inputs returned the clean inputs; the hook's copy was only verified) — the 'corrupted updates applied' counterfactual was empty. Fixed: guard_enabled=False now returns the tampered batch; rerun verified (on/off losses diverge). off_20260825 pre-fix evidence removed. See docs/audits/2026-08-26_independent_audit.md.
honest_notes: E1 measures fault blocking and damage avoidance, NOT training quality: beta=0 (no KL), 30 steps, in-train reward only; success deltas between arms are noise at this scale
F2 detection requires the batch to carry old_per_token_logps (TRL importance-sampling path); if upstream never produces them, the guard can only enforce the length contract (documented blind spot)
The step seam verifies the actual tensors the loss consumes (verified in _prepare_inputs); records are consumed per-slice, a row can never be reused
optimizer.step() is capability-gated on this path (no capability -> GuardViolation)
